page.notes: The decorative rule between the paragraph on the seven classes and the chapter heading is an ornament, not text, and is not transcribed. The first paragraph has no indent and is treated as continuing from the previous page. The page number is printed as "441" (the final digit is set in old type). The italic and roman distinctions in the list of classes are read from the scan and may not be exact. "ptascribemus" is doubtful; the printed letters "pt" are unclear. The sentence "Videat, qui volet, in hanc senten-" continues on the next page. The printed note "Naturalis, Platonem." beside the Plato paragraph is read as part of the note "Unde varietas ingeniorum juxta Platonem."
